concept.title: Work with your tree
concept.shortdesc: Find people, add people and families, read their events and sources, and write notes.

conbody.p: This chapter is for everything you do once a tree is open. It starts with a picture of every screen. Then it shows how to find a person, how to read what the app knows about them, and how to add more. Each page has a few steps and a picture of the result.
The pictures use one small tree: the family of Patrick Brontë of Haworth, a village in Yorkshire. You can build it yourself, a little at a time, as you read.
